title: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful beef stew made with tender beef and a variety of aromatics. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the beef to a slow cooker.
Add the onion, pepper, carrot, and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked vegetables to the slow cooker with the beef.
Pour in the stew (beef broth) and stir to combine.
Cover the slow cooker and cook on low for 8-10 hours or high for 4-6 hours.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
